comment: Document cases against schema.json. expect is accepted, legacy_document, or refused with a verdict of malformed, foreign_field or forbidden_content; must_name lists the full paths and words the refusal must contain. Each refused case carries exactly one defect. Delegated subtrees (sensor protocol keys, skill config beyond the declared key) are validated by their own contracts, and the checker passes them through only where that contract is named.

cases.name: minimal_document_accepted
cases.note: Every optional section absent; defaults apply at every depth.

cases.name: full_example_accepted
cases.note: The shipped ori.yaml.example after the documented migration.

cases.name: legacy_document_recognised
cases.note: No schema marker: a single-document configuration from before the split. Not malformed; the consumer applies the migration rules and the one-way latch.

cases.name: unknown_schema_marker_refused
cases.note: A marker this version does not define.

cases.name: unknown_top_level_key_refused
cases.note: A section nothing reads.

cases.name: undeclared_key_two_levels_deep_refused
cases.note: The refusal names the full path, not the leaf.

cases.name: rated_capacity_amps_is_foreign
cases.note: Reads as inventory and is a safety parameter; the refusal names where it now lives.

cases.name: relay_active_high_is_foreign
cases.note: Driver polarity is a commissioned actuator fact.

cases.name: entitlement_anchor_in_document_forbidden
cases.note: The provisioning signer may not choose the key that verifies entitlement.

cases.name: offline_token_anchor_in_document_forbidden
cases.note: The key that verifies Tier C offline approvals is an anchor, not a value.

cases.name: evidence_authority_keys_path_forbidden
cases.note: Release-owned.

cases.name: evidence_checkpoint_interval_forbidden
cases.note: Release-owned.

cases.name: tls_insecure_skip_verify_refused
cases.note: Not a setting.

cases.name: tls_insecure_refused
cases.note: The short spelling is not a setting either.

cases.name: boolean_as_string_refused
cases.note: "true" is a string. The v1 loader coerced it; v2 does not.

cases.name: float_where_integer_refused
cases.note: 5.0 is not 5.

cases.name: boolean_where_integer_refused
cases.note: true is not 1.

cases.name: integer_where_string_refused
cases.note: A numeric id is not a string id.

cases.name: inventory_generation_missing_refused
cases.note: A v2 document declares an inventory, so there must be a generation to name.

cases.name: inventory_generation_zero_refused
cases.note: Zero is a binding to absence.

cases.name: required_device_field_missing_refused
cases.note: device.location is required.

cases.name: enum_violation_refused
cases.note: A deployment profile outside the vocabulary.

cases.name: below_minimum_refused
cases.note: telemetry_export.batch_size below 1.

cases.name: above_maximum_refused
cases.note: BCM pin 28 does not exist on the supported header.

cases.name: exclusive_minimum_refused
cases.note: A zero retry interval is a busy loop.

cases.name: socket_mode_as_integer_refused
cases.note: The document carries a quoted octal string; an integer is refused so that YAML 1.1 and 1.2 parsers cannot disagree about it.

cases.name: socket_mode_bad_shape_refused
cases.note: Not 0oNNN.

cases.name: device_id_with_space_refused
cases.note: device.id is an identity used in topics and client ids; a space is refused by pattern.

cases.name: country_code_lowercase_refused
cases.note: ISO alpha-2 is upper case; the loader upper-cased it, v2 does not.

cases.name: env_name_with_hyphen_refused
cases.note: An environment variable name cannot carry a hyphen.

cases.name: custody_key_id_malformed_refused
cases.note: Retired custody generations are named by a fixed shape.

cases.name: skill_digest_malformed_refused
cases.note: Not sha256:<64 hex>.

cases.name: skill_config_dead_key_refused
cases.note: A key the runtime never reads. Under skills-package/v3 it would be validated against the package's config_schema; a consumer without v3 refuses it.

cases.name: skill_approval_timeout_accepted
cases.note: The one config key the runtime reads.

cases.name: coap_command_bad_method_refused
cases.note: Map entries are closed too.

cases.name: coap_command_undeclared_key_refused
cases.note: An undeclared key inside a map entry.

cases.name: allowed_senders_unknown_channel_refused
cases.note: Channels are a closed set.

cases.name: array_item_wrong_type_refused
cases.note: An integer in a list of strings.

cases.name: signing_key_missing_refused
cases.note: A v2 envelope names the key that signed it, so that authority can be decided over a verified document rather than by which anchor happened to succeed.

cases.name: signing_key_non_canonical_refused
cases.note: Canonical base64 of exactly 32 bytes; four spellings of one key would otherwise be four signing inputs.

cases.name: config_signature_undeclared_key_refused
cases.note: The envelope is closed as well.

cases.name: null_section_refused
cases.note: null is not an object. The v1 loader read it as empty; v2 does not.

cases.name: sensor_protocol_keys_delegated
cases.note: Protocol keys beside the envelope are validated by sensor-configuration/v1, not here.

cases.name: sensor_envelope_type_refused
cases.note: The envelope itself is typed here: a string poll interval is refused before any adapter schema is consulted.
